cohort: 700 women presenting with oligohydramnios at >32 weeks of gestation at Bahawal Victoria Hospital, Bahawalpur, Pakistan
finding: Oligohydramnios was associated with a 3% incidence rate, 8% congenital anomaly rate, 12% IUGR rate, 6% stillbirth rate, 25% NICU admission rate, and 6% ENND rate.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 48% of the participants, while 52% delivered vaginally.
